2.text: Ability to split a blade of grass with the point of an arrow was proof of the

3.text: greatest skill of the archer. Nowadays only the toy-bows of children are put

4.text: to their full use; and shooting with small arrows is practised much in the

5.text: same way as in former times, the children beginning at a very early age.
